integrity: Exact finite Markov-chain checks and algebraic certificate supplement a general proof. Historical priority remains subject to further literature and independent review.
limitations: Two independent equal-holding synchronous walkers starting in opposite parts of complete bipartite graphs; first vertex coincidence only; no assertion about adaptive, continuous-time or unequal holding rates.
title: Exact mean rendezvous times and a cube-root laziness transition on complete bipartite graphs
